summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing of Singo cyberpunk bingo app completed successfully. All major features working including 6 win patterns, toggle daub, bar mode with admin password 5749, multiplayer rooms, leaderboard, sound effects, and cyberpunk styling.

design_issues.issue: Musical notes background component not rendering or testid missing
Multiplayer pages use different styling (cream background, NeoCard) instead of consistent cyberpunk dark theme

passed_tests: Homepage loads with SINGO title and cyberpunk styling
Three mode cards (Single Player, Bar Mode, Multiplayer) all clickable
Leaderboard displays 19 entries with proper ranking and cyberpunk styling
Single Player setup with name input, card count (1-4), and pattern selection
All 6 win patterns available and selectable (Any, Line, Diagonal, Four Corners, X, Full House)
Single Player game creates 2 bingo cards with proper B-I-N-G-O headers
Auto-daub checkbox and toggle functionality works
Toggle daub - click to mark/unmark cells works perfectly
Manual number calling and auto-call toggle (ON/OFF) functional
Sound controls toggle (ON/OFF) functional
Bar Mode admin password validation - rejects wrong passwords, accepts 5749
Bar Mode admin view shows only called numbers board and controls
Bar Mode player view shows only fullscreen bingo card
Bar Mode role selection (player/admin) works correctly
Multiplayer room creation and joining functional
Room capacity display (1/4 Players) and host indicator working
Start game button correctly disabled until 2+ players
Navigation buttons (Back to Home, Leave Game, New Game) all functional
Called numbers board with current number display and grid highlighting
Bingo card cyberpunk styling with neon borders and gradients
Win pattern storage and retrieval working for all 6 patterns
WebSocket connectivity for real-time updates functional
Responsive design maintains functionality across viewport sizes
success_percentage: Backend: 100% (27/27 tests passed), Frontend: 95% (23/24 major features working)
action_item_for_main_agent: Minor styling consistency fix: Update multiplayer pages to use cyberpunk dark theme instead of cream background for visual consistency. Optional: Add musical notes background component testid or fix rendering.
